title: Supplementary Materials for "Was That Real?" Understanding How Users Interpret Anomalous Spatial Audio in Virtual Reality
description: Supplementary materials for a user study on how users in virtual reality recognize, attribute, and experience anomalous spatial audio (IEEE MetaCom 2026). Includes the authors' human-voice stimulus and source links for the other stimuli, a demo video of the VR task, the questionnaire and semi-structured interview guide (Japanese and English), the interview codebook, and per-presentation head-orientation telemetry. The authors' materials are released under CC BY 4.0; see README.md for exceptions (demo video audio by MUSMUS, SUS items by Brooke, and externally sourced stimuli).
